rubric.rule: Labels answer one question: should a recruiter shortlist this candidate for this job? high = yes, meets the minimum experience and most required skills with professional evidence; medium = worth a screen, transferable background or a notable gap, within about one year of the minimum; low = no, core requirements absent, more than one year short, unrelated domain, or no extractable content. Incidental or coursework-only use of a skill does not count as professional evidence.

backend_junior.title: Junior Backend Developer (Python)
backend_junior.text:
Job Title: Junior Backend Developer (Python)
Location: Remote

We are hiring a junior backend developer to help build and maintain our internal APIs.

Requirements:
- 1+ year of professional Python experience
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
- Experience building or consuming REST APIs
- Familiarity with Git
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have:
- Django or Flask
- Docker

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain REST endpoints
- Write and review SQL queries
- Collaborate with the frontend team

data_analyst.title: Data Analyst
data_analyst.text:
Role: Data Analyst
We need a data analyst to support the growth team with reporting and experimentation.

Must have:
- 2+ years of experience in an analytics role
- Advanced SQL
- Advanced Excel
- Python with pandas for analysis
- Experience building data visualizations

Preferred:
- Tableau or Power BI
- A background in statistics

Education: Bachelor's degree.

frontend_senior.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
frontend_senior.text:
Senior Frontend Engineer

You will own our customer-facing React application.

What we expect:
- 3+ years of frontend development experience
- Expert-level JavaScript
- Production experience with React
- Strong HTML and CSS skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Bonus:
- TypeScript
- Next.js
- Automated testing (Jest, Playwright, or similar)

ml_engineer.title: Machine Learning Engineer
ml_engineer.text:
Machine Learning Engineer
Build and deploy production ML systems for our recommendations team.

Required:
- 3+ years of machine learning engineering experience
- Strong Python
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Solid understanding of classical machine learning
- Experience with MLOps: model deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD

Preferred:
- Experience with LLMs
- Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Master's degree in a quantitative field

items.notes: 2.5 years of Python backend work, all four required skills evidenced, CS degree.
